regions.today: A humid and mostly cloudy with patchy rain, though some sunshine will break through at times. Highest temperatures of 17 to 22 degrees, with light to moderate southeasterly winds veering southwesterly and freshening.
regions.tonight: Starting off mostly cloudy with well-scattered showers. Clear spells will become more frequent as the night progresses. A mild night with lowest temperatures ranging from 11 degrees in the north to 16 degrees in the south, with a light to moderate southwesterly breeze.
regions.tomorrow: A dry start for many with just a few showers about and also some sunny spells. However, it will turn wet for the afternoon and evening with widespread rain developing. The rain will be heavy and persistent at times. Highest temperatures of 17 to 20 degrees, with moderate to fresh southwesterly winds.
